title: Control-phase reduction rule
statement: For each natural number $k$, define a partial reduction from a control key and its phase state to a new control key and phase state as follows. Entry advances to lookup; lookup advances to state-tail precisely when its state is the empty-key done state; state-tail and state-home advance, on their done state, to state-home and clear-state, respectively; clear-state advances from done to to-summary at position $0$; to-summary advances from position $2$ to record; record advances from its halting state to to-state at position $0$; to-state advances from position $2$ to successor at the tag phase; a completed successor field advances to table-tail, which on completion advances to table-home, then to state-gap, then to state-restore, and finally to finish, preserving the live flag at each step; finish at position $2$ advances to the exit state determined by that flag. In every other case the reduction is undefined.
hypotheses_covered: control key and corresponding phase state
